card.name: Statistics and headline-list text
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens in statistical web text, such as 'from' in 'Percent change from previous month', digits inside percentages, and separator dashes in headline lists.

modes.label: Statistical table wording
modes.description: Words or digits inside percent-change or poverty-rate statistics.

modes.label: Headline list dashes
modes.description: A dash separating article titles in a list of links.
modes.example: Just Add Chia <<->> Well: The Scientific 7-Min

card.plain: It fires on scattered words and symbols in statistics tables and news-headline lists, with no single clear meaning.
